conclusions.text: The Greek Ministry 2024 publication reports 332 municipalities and 13 Regions, and says municipalities and Regions have no hierarchical relationship/control.

All 226 scoped Greek Atlas rows map to the pinned 2010 Greek ADM3 source IDs/names and comprise 227 native source features because one Atlas multipart row combines two. This proves source lineage only.
The 2010 source-to-current Greek municipality identities and completeness remain unresolved; a count difference does not localize missing/corrected records.

The seven-feature Kosovo source archive conflicts with its own 48-unit/municipality metadata and KAS current municipality count; no scoped Atlas district is established as a current municipality polygon.
Mount Athos role, fallback parent assignments, current island/city completeness and exact legal boundary identities are unresolved.
